technical_decisions.recommendation: Use a dedicated permitted8–128-character key (hex64 fits), same-host UTF8text keyfile and canonical changed/deleted public URLs. Verify200/plain-text, not HTML fallback. POST accepts up to10000URLs. HTTP200means receipt, not indexing or AI citation.

technical_decisions.finding: OAI-SearchBot search access and GPTBot training control are independent; ChatGPT-User is user initiated, not automatic search crawling.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Owner chooses training separately from search discovery. Verify documented bot IPs/CDN behavior; no citation guarantee.

technical_decisions.finding: Live robots permits all user agents; generic-client200does not prove crawler/WAF access.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Preserve security controls and verify legitimate bot logs/IPs. Perplexity documents its search crawler separately from foundation-model training. Current Claude crawler documentation did not retrieve; do not invent unsupported bot rules.

technical_decisions.finding: Ordinary Search eligibility and useful public content apply; no special AI schema or llms.txt required.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Use original technical answers, accurate service proof and consistent entities; never promise citations or manufacture RTA approval/projects/reviews.

technical_decisions.finding: One current Google guide links a GenerativeAIperformance report while AI-features guidance still describes aggregateWebdata; detailed public report methodology did not render. Bing documents AI Performance and Topics beta.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Root verifies actual property/report availability. Keep unavailable traffic/citation metrics null, distinct from identifiable referrals.

technical_decisions.finding: Microsoft announced independent training/grounding preferences30October2026; new preferences begin1February2027 with2027transition dates.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Treat as a future owner-policy decision, not a completed/currently enforced integration; do not block grounding merely to opt out of training.

technical_decisions.finding: Yahoo routes submissions to Bing; DuckDuckGo largely uses Bing for traditional links; Ecosia varies among Bing/Google/EUSP.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Prioritize Google/Bing, canonical sitemap and actual qualified referrals; no guaranteed downstream indexing.

technical_decisions.finding: Public GeneralContractor JSON-LD has consistent contact/address/corporate-social sameAs. Robots and nine-URL sitemap returned200.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Keep schema aligned with visible verified facts; reconcile sitemap with new code and authenticated index reports. No fabricated ratings/certifications/projects.

technical_decisions.finding: Local listings, buyer registration and paid project intelligence are different workflows.
technical_decisions.recommendation: Verify existing organizations/qualification and owner-approved documents. No binding declarations, paid subscriptions, bid submission or automated paid-portal extraction/outreach.

pending_owner_actions: Confirm legal identity, history, precise RTA scope/conditions and ISO renewal evidence before certification/approval claims.
Root verifies existing Google/Bing properties and Ads/GA4/GTM/Clarity ownership, live receipt, goals and linking; do not duplicate.
Verify Yellow Pages control/legal continuity before fixing the Voltronix/NSTS description.
Verify existing VOLTRONIX local listings and serving model; check Apple Business migrated locations before duplicates.
Verify social ownership, legacy X/Pinterest branding, content rights and intended WhatsApp number.
Approve independent search/training policy and any IndexNow key/deployment/submission; verify actual WAF behavior.
Verify supplier licenses/categories/documents and existing registrations; owner approves commitments and subscriptions.
Explicit approval before campaign publication, billing/budget changes or charges; optimize for real qualified enquiries and projects.
